claims.claim: The repaired isolated Curator host completed the original retained Briefing while the installation was Off, preserved the classification receipt and Keeper memory, and published the matching observer acknowledgement without recreating the worker; re-enabling the installation must keep these original results immutable and process newly admitted facts separately.

Curator authority boundary. The Workspace Curator Addon computes classification and briefing, while the MASC host retains durable fact intake, original request identity, memory ledger commits, observer acknowledgements, and effect authority. Disabling the installation must preserve pending original work for reattachment.
